description: Φρεάτια στη χώρα της Ν. Νάξου (γραμμικά) is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Δήμος Νάξου και Μικρών Κυκλάδων. Γραμμικό σύνολο δεδομένων που περιλαμβάνει τα φρεάτια στη χώρα της Νάξου. Πηγή: Κτηματογράφηση - Πολεοδόμηση - Πράξη Εφαρμογής Περιοχών Επέκτασης Σχεδίου Πόλης Δ. Νάξου. Coverage: Δήμος Νάξου και Μικρών Κυκλάδων. The publisher named on the listing is Δήμος Νάξου και Μικρών Κυκλάδων. Its keywords include γεωχωρικά, features, naxos, inspire, gis. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, XML, WMS, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2026-05-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
